data.gender_notes: Ardussi is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word ‘ardous’, meaning ‘mountainous’, ‘arduous’, ‘ardent’, ‘strong’, and ‘valiant’. This name was borne by Saint Ardusius, a bishop of Cologne during the 13th century. The name Ardussi carries the meaning “Strong, mountainous” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ardussi usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, mountainous and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ardussi total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
